_schema: Frozen Season 1 results, read by /results. status: 'pending' (empty state, winners TBD) | 'final' (populated after the WaveWarZ battles). Fill winners.<track> with {name, handle, url, project} and the recap numbers once the three battles settle (window closes 2026-08-30), then flip status to 'final'. This is a static record - no live widgets. 'voters' was dropped when the month-two quadratic vote was retired; 'entrants' replaces it.
_winners_note: artist written 2026-08-28 on Zaal's word (meeting card 2026-08-25, 'Record n3m as artist champion'). charts is the charts-signal winner for that battle, a separate confirmation Zaal has not given yet, so it stays null and does not mean n3m lost the charts. results.html reads name, url, project only.

recap.summary: Three months, open to anyone, any tool. 31 recorded workshop sessions ran through June. 31 projects came in from 15 people across the artist, builder and creator tracks. Two people per track reached the Finals, and the six went head to head live on WaveWarZ in the last week of August.
